homepage.features.sectionHeading.message: Everything you need for mainframe DevOps
homepage.features.sectionHeading.description: Main heading of the features section

homepage.feature.binary.description.message: A single binary {a4z} orchestrates local tasks (shell, HTTP, filesystem) and z/OS tasks (JCL jobs, datasets, copybooks) in the same workflow YAML — no runtime to install.

homepage.feature.declarative.description.message: YAML syntax inspired by GitHub Actions, adapted for the mainframe. Automatic DAG, {expr} expressions, typed inputs, {needs}, {if_}, {timeout} — fine-grained control of every step.

homepage.feature.tasks.description.message: From shell to mainframe: {zosjobs}, datasets, copybooks, test datasets, {datacompare}, spool-analyze, {zosbuild}… — everything in the binary, no external dependencies.

homepage.feature.batchtests.description.message: The {tests} block runs your jobs, analyzes their spools, compares their files field by field — and publishes a {junit} that Jenkins and GitLab render natively.

homepage.feature.build.description.message: {sourcescan} maps your COBOL dependencies, {buildimpact} computes what to recompile from a Git diff, {zosbuild} compiles through z/OSMF — nothing to install on the LPAR.

homepage.feature.lint.description.message: {lint} validates the YAML and detects cycles. {plan} shows the parallel execution levels. Zero surprises in production.

homepage.feature.security.description.message: Secrets never in the YAML — {secret} variables automatically masked in logs and run artifacts. Zowe profile compatibility.

homepage.feature.crossplatform.descripti.message: Linux, macOS, Windows × amd64 / arm64. Run artifacts stored under {runs}. Automatic rotation. Machine-readable JSON output.

homepage.license.note.message: Proprietary software — use is governed by the {eula}. Your workflows and your data remain yours.
homepage.license.note.description: License note under the homepage CTAs

homepage.license.link.description: Link text of the homepage license note

homepage.feature.ai.description.message: The {aiprompt} task calls an LLM to explain an abend or summarize a listing — endpoints declared in the profile (never a URL or key in the YAML), {anonymized} context statically enforced on the DAG, and the AI stays consultative: it executes nothing, decides nothing.
